glassmediaplayer.settings.title: Media player settings
glassmediaplayer.settings.drag_note: Open chat to move the island with the mouse
glassmediaplayer.settings.credit: Glass after ReGlass by RedxAx  ·  Glass MediaPlayer Island by pers1k1
glassmediaplayer.drag.hint: LMB: move  ·  Wheel: size  ·  RMB: reset
glassmediaplayer.settings.flag.media.hin: Show the track playing in browsers and players on Windows
glassmediaplayer.settings.flag.card.hint: Open the island into a big card when a new track starts
glassmediaplayer.settings.flag.avatar.hi: Your skin head at the left edge of the island
glassmediaplayer.settings.flag.nick.hint: Your nickname while nothing is playing
glassmediaplayer.settings.flag.ping.hint: Latency to the server, colored when it gets slow
glassmediaplayer.settings.flag.statsWith: Keep the FPS and ping capsule under the island while music plays
glassmediaplayer.settings.flag.cover.hin: Cover of the playing track in place of the head
glassmediaplayer.settings.flag.coverTint: Visualizer bars take their colors from the cover
glassmediaplayer.settings.flag.title: Title
glassmediaplayer.settings.flag.lyrics.hi: Synced lyrics in place of the title, lit letter by letter. Looked up on lrclib.net: the title and artist of the track are sent there
glassmediaplayer.settings.flag.time.hint: Elapsed and total time of the track
glassmediaplayer.settings.flag.bar.hint: How far the track has played
glassmediaplayer.settings.flag.visualize: Bars that dance to the sound of the player
glassmediaplayer.settings.flag.modFont.h: Inter, the typeface of BattleCraft. Off: the vanilla Minecraft font
glassmediaplayer.settings.dial.cardSecon: How long the card stays open after a track change, from %s to %s seconds
glassmediaplayer.settings.dial.visualize: How tall the bars get, 1 is normal, from %s to %s
How often the bars follow the sound, 1 is normal, from %s to %s
How fast the bars jump on a beat, 1 is normal, from %s to %s
Brightness of colors taken from the cover, 1 is normal, from %s to %s
Saturation of colors taken from the cover, 1 is normal, from %s to %s
glassmediaplayer.settings.dial.flipSpeed: How fast the cover turns over on a track change, 1 is normal, from %s to %s
glassmediaplayer.settings.dial.lyricsOff: Move the lyrics later (plus) or earlier (minus) if they run off the singing, from %s to %s seconds
